about: Input for tools/comfy/palette_extract.py: where each material is sampled on the approved front concept. Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in concept pixels (1536x1024, origin top-left, x1/y1 exclusive); hue in degrees, sat/val in 0-1 (HSV). The concept's ground is a flat dark navy (RGB ~22,32,43) that sits within a few units of her black bodysuit, so the graph's birefnet figure mask (mask; from run_trellis.py --mask-only) replaces the flat-background test. tones = CIELAB L* percentiles reported as shadow/base/highlight (emissive: rim/hot/core). Edit a box, re-run the tool, look at reports/stage0_palette_samples.png.
title: SELENE
subtitle: The Stormcaller  -  colour callouts
header_note: Measured from the approved T-pose front (references/SELENE_front_approved.png) inside the birefnet figure mask. Derived data, not new design. The two floating coils are weapon/VFX, not body: not sampled.
value_note: Selene is a DARK slender core (black bodysuit, leggings, sabatons, gauntlets: L* 8-20) inside a LIGHT-MID fan of storm-blue cloth (panels and cape: a gradient from deep blue to pale storm-cloud). Skin and silver hair are the light accents at the top; thin gold trim is the MID accent; the ice-blue glow (eyes, collar gem, arm veins, greave glows) sits above everything and is kept small, so the P2 player cyan never becomes a large area.

swatches.label: Skin
swatches.note: pale cool skin: face, shoulders, bare arms (the veins are painted on top)

swatches.label: Silver-white hair
swatches.note: high bun and swept strands; the lightest non-glowing value on her

swatches.label: Eye glow
swatches.note: ice-blue eyes; 1-2 px at game scale, the face reads as a pale oval with two points

swatches.label: Collar gem
swatches.note: the blue diamond at the high collar: her centre mark from the 55-degree camera

swatches.label: Lightning veins
swatches.note: tattoo veins on both bare arms; thin emissive lines, Static Charge can scale them

swatches.label: Black bodysuit
swatches.note: high-collared sleeveless suit: near-black with a navy cast; lit faces lift to the highlight tone

swatches.label: Leggings
swatches.note: black leggings under the panels, fine gold seams

swatches.label: Gold filigree trim
swatches.note: collar straps, belt rings, hip plates, knee and greave edges: thin rims only

swatches.label: Fingerless gauntlets
swatches.note: dark leather-and-plate gauntlets from mid-forearm to the knuckles

swatches.label: Tabard centre panel
swatches.note: the long pale storm-blue front panel between the legs, gold-veined

swatches.label: Side panels (storm blue)
swatches.note: the long hip panels: cyan-blue at the top fading down to pale storm-cloud

swatches.label: Cape (deep storm blue)
swatches.note: the outer shoulder capes: saturated deep blue, the largest colour area

swatches.label: Cape (storm-cloud edge)
swatches.note: the ragged pale grey-blue fade at the cape and panel edges

swatches.label: Greaves & sabatons
swatches.note: dark navy armour plates with gold edges, pointed toes

swatches.label: Greave glow
swatches.note: cyan V-glows on the greaves and sabaton edges

pairs: one black suit material for torso and legs
the armour is the same dark navy family, a touch bluer
the tabard is the middle of the storm gradient, the ragged edges its pale end
checks.content_note: the kit colour is her lightning glow
checks.bg_note: the black suit sits on the dark navy ground by value alone; skin, hair, the blue cloth fan and the glows carry the silhouette
